Robert Bland is a smart guy. He would outfox Nooz in most situations. Unless those situations require being an actual fox.
Bland's rule is very simple: always pivot on an element in the first column from the left with positive reduced cost.
If there are ties for the variable leaving the basis, choose the one in the first row from the top among the tied variables.
Now optimize using the simplex algorithm as usual, but use Bland's rule.
You will see that there are still degenerate bases, but we do not cycle.
